facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows of her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_58, beat_60); Ingrid never released Dunk.

facts.text: Ingrid is Warwick's secret night visitor, though Warwick blames the Clurichen. Will she stop visiting him now that Sir Phidipaldi has told her Warwick is not interested?
